intent: Implement IngressPacketRequest (Java 21, Spring Boot 3, WebFlux/Reactor/R2DBC, constructor injection, no blocking calls) so that the frozen test passes, providing exactly the ast_hints table and nothing improvised. Unit contract: Context Telemetry Ingestion & Validation interface-layer DTO: ONE JSON document describing one Ingress Packet {deviceId, sourceKind, samples:[{metric, tDeviceEpochMillis, value}]} (a single object, not an array and not a stream). Declares Jakarta Validation constraints (@NotBlank, @NotEmpty, @NotNull, @Valid on nested elements); the constraints are ACTIVATED by @Valid on the request parameter of IngestionController. Application ports never see this type.

methods.signature: IngressPacketRequest(String deviceId, String sourceKind, List<SampleRequest> samples)
methods.semantics: Plain transport record; constraints declared as Jakarta Validation annotations.

Maps to the domain: every sample gets ValidationStatus.UNVALIDATED and the given tIngress; an unknown sourceKind or metric name throws IllegalArgumentException; tDevice = Instant.ofEpochMilli(tDeviceEpochMillis).

methods.signature: SampleRequest(String metric, Long tDeviceEpochMillis, Double value)
methods.semantics: Nested record IngressPacketRequest.SampleRequest; @NotBlank metric, @NotNull tDeviceEpochMillis, @NotNull value
